subject: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning
overview: The board held a public hearing on proposed zoning amendments to establish the Salem Street Corridor District and create a Green Score zoning regulation. Following a detailed presentation and extensive public comment regarding traffic, density, and neighborhood impacts, the board voted to continue the hearing to February 5, 2025.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor District and Green Score Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Continued to February 5, 2025, a public hearing on proposed zoning ordinance and map amendments establishing the Salem Street Corridor District and Green Score regulations. Consultants presented proposed subdistricts, height allowances, and incentive zoning options, which drew significant public testimony raising concerns about traffic, parking, six-story maximum heights, and proximity to the Roberts Elementary School before the board deferred the Green Score presentation.
